# Hygiene denylist for the public repository, read by check_client_data.py.
# One entry per line. A plain line is a literal, case insensitive term.
# A line starting with "re:" is a case sensitive regular expression.
# Matches fail the gate; the output masks the matched term.
#
# This public file holds credential shapes and wording that must never appear
# in the product repository. Client and business specific terms live in a
# private list held outside this repository and are checked before publishing.

# Credential shapes
re:hca_live_[a-z0-9]{6,}_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}
re:AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}
re:ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}
re:github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}
re:AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}
re:xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
re:sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}
re:-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----
re:"private_key_id"\s*:

# Wording that does not belong in a product repository
re:\b[Pp]ortfolio\b
re:\b[Hh]iring\b
re:\b[Ee]mployer\b
re:\b[Rr]ecruiter\b
re:\b[Jj]ob application\b
